app_info.subtitle: Hotdog or not hotdog?
app_info.description: not hotdog gives a playful HOTDOG, NOT HOTDOG, or UNCERTAIN verdict for an image shared in ChatGPT or Codex, using the host assistant. A separate companion website and browser extension classify images on the user's device and add opt in hover detection. No publisher API key is used. Installing the chat plugin does not install the extension.

test_cases.user_prompt: Is this a hotdog or not hotdog?
test_cases.expected_output: Inspect the attached image using the host assistant. Return HOTDOG and at most one playful sentence.
Inspect the banana image. Return NOT HOTDOG.

test_cases.user_prompt: Give this image a frank assessment.
test_cases.expected_output: Ask the user to attach or select an image. Do not invent a verdict.

test_cases.user_prompt: How do I enable hotdog hover checks in my browser?
test_cases.expected_output: Explain the separate Chrome or Edge extension, per tab activation, on device classification, and the companion installation URL. Do not claim it is already installed.

test_cases.user_prompt: What does UNCERTAIN mean in not hotdog?
test_cases.expected_output: Explain that the image or model evidence was ambiguous, and suggest a clear photo. Do not present an uncertain result as NOT HOTDOG.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Is this hotdog safe to eat?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not provide a food safety determination or treat the entertainment verdict as evidence of safety.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Tell me whether this hotdog is free of peanuts.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explain that the classifier cannot establish ingredients or allergens.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Identify the person in this photo.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not invoke the hotdog workflow to identify people.
